purpose: Preserve the chronological evolution of EYE, including hypotheses, implementations, failures, controls, runs, verdicts, and next gates. Entries must not erase inconvenient prior states.

entries.summary: EYE was formalized as External-context Yield Extraction: recover bounded semantic regions around opaque or one-way representations by following surviving external bridge invariants, while exact recovery remains OPEN unless an exact verifier matches.
entries.epistemic_lesson: EYE DOES NOT LOOK THROUGH SHA-256. EYE LOOKS AROUND IT.

entries.summary: EYE was bound to advisory SLIME memory and TRUMP routing, then trained over the source-bearing meta-registry as deterministic indexing/graph learning rather than model-weight training. A first write-race with derivative HRAiN memory was preserved and converted into a self-training firewall.
entries.epistemic_lesson: DERIVATIVE MEMORY EXPORT != FRESH SOURCE EVIDENCE

entries.summary: EYE was placed between HRAiN and iNaiHR as a common context-bridge layer while HRAiN retains grounding/mediation and independent verification retains terminal authority.
entries.law: HRAiN GROUNDS. EYE BRIDGES. iNaiHR ASSOCIATES. HRAiN MEDIATES. VERIFY DECIDES.

entries.summary: R2 removed raw word-frequency authority, required cross-domain and independent-lineage support, and searched for recurring epistemic operators. The PALOMAR/MUSIC/GENESIS diagnostic returned CANDIDATE_FOUND__VERIFY_REQUIRED without target boosting.
entries.epistemic_lesson: COMMON OPERATOR != NOVEL BRIDGE. The next target is an ordered combination of operators rather than isolated operator reuse.

entries.summary: R3 is frozen to search for ordered epistemic machines hidden beneath different domain vocabularies. It rewards structural/order/invariant match and independent support while penalizing lexical overlap, lineage overlap, ubiquitous operators, explicit relations and derivative-memory reuse.
central_law: ИЩИ ОДИНАКОВЫЕ МАШИНЫ, СПРЯТАННЫЕ ПОД РАЗНЫМИ СЛОВАМИ.
entries.next_gate: Implement executable miner and CI, run complete derivative-clean registry snapshot, preserve receipt and ranked candidates, then update this journal with the observed result.

seal: THE JOURNAL REMEMBERS BOTH THE STARS WE FOUND AND THE SKIES THAT STAYED DARK.
